offSociety.title: MAIA OFF Society
offSociety.primaryText: For those building something big while trying to understand themselves.
offSociety.secondaryText: Ideas, signals and conversations for a generation that learned to look well before feeling well.
offSociety.caption: A private room inside MAIA. Less noise. More direction.
offSociety.signalCaption: Move slowly. Each signal is designed to stay for a moment.

signals.title: It looks good… but it feels OFF.
signals.text: Some people seem to be moving all the time… and still feel that something does not connect.

signals.title: Productivity without direction is also exhausting.
signals.text: Not all exhaustion comes from work. Sometimes it comes from building without clarity.

signals.title: You are not behind. You are saturated.
signals.text: We live exposed to too many lives, too many goals and too much pressure at once.

signals.title: The problem is not always lack of talent.
signals.text: Sometimes it is too much noise, comparison and impossible expectations to sustain.

signals.title: OFF does not always mean lost.
signals.text: Sometimes it means you can no longer keep growing from inertia.

signals.title: Building should also feel like yours.
signals.text: MAIA OFF Society exists for those who want to grow without losing themselves in the process.
